## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] Source registry / source review
- [ ] Prompt data
- [ ] License / provenance correction
- [ ] Data-quality correction
- [ ] Schema / metadata model
- [ ] Documentation / policy
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Affected sources / records

List source IDs, record IDs, paths, or `N/A`.

## Evidence

For licensing/provenance changes, link to primary evidence: canonical source, exact license declaration, revision/commit, dataset card, or equivalent.

## Prompt-content impact

- [ ] No prompt text changed
- [ ] Prompt text changed and the transformation is documented
- [ ] Prompt records were added from an `approved` source
- [ ] Prompt records were removed/quarantined
- [ ] Not applicable

## Review checklist

- [ ] I did not treat public availability as redistribution permission.
- [ ] I did not add Carnaverone Studio first-party/proprietary prompts.
- [ ] New prompt data, if any, comes only from sources marked `approved`.
- [ ] Required attribution and provenance are preserved.
- [ ] Third-party media was not mirrored without separate rights verification.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, secrets, private data, or access-controlled content.
- [ ] Any uncertainty is stated explicitly rather than guessed.
- [ ] Relevant documentation/schema references have been updated when necessary.

## Additional notes

Add known limitations, unresolved questions, or reviewer context.
